query: Loading many workflows pops 'Invalid workflow against zod schema' errors (Invalid semantic version at nodes[..].properties.ver; later aux_id format errors) on every page switch. Workflows still run but the modal is constant noise.

desired.outcome: Confirmed workaround: Settings > disable 'workflow validation'. Root cause: frontend PR #2751 added semantic-version/aux_id regex validation flagging non-semver node pack 'ver' fields; fix merged in ComfyUI frontend.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Recognize the zod-schema modal is frontend PR #2751 regex-validating non-semver node-pack 'ver' fields, and that disabling workflow validation silences it (real fix merged in frontend).
